resources.string: Shows media volume percent. Tap the dial to open the app. Use + and − for 10 percent steps. Continuous rotation is only available in the app.
Sets how far the volume buttons move media volume.

Volume Control reads only the volume up and volume down buttons, so each press can move Samsung media volume by the step you pick in the app. It does not read anything on screen, other keys, or what you type. The step works only while the screen is on. With the screen off the service stops reading the buttons. If the buttons misbehave with the screen off, turn this service off.
